title: One Quarter of Americans Embarrassed by Coffee Order
paragraphs: Do you have a favorite coffee that you are too shy to order in front of other people? If so, you are not alone. According to a new survey, almost a quarter of Americans who drink coffee have a "secret" coffee order.
The survey was done by Talker Research. Between September 23 and September 28, 2026, it asked 1,586 Americans who drink coffee about their coffee habits.

The survey found that 23% of coffee drinkers have a coffee order that they only get in secret. They do this because they think other people will judge them for it. These people may be worried about what their friends think, or even what the barista, the person who makes the coffee, thinks.
These worries may not be completely wrong. The survey also found that about one in three Americans judge other people by their coffee order.

Coffee can be ordered in many different ways, with different sizes, types of milk, flavors and toppings. Some people like simple black coffee, while others prefer sweet drinks with lots of extras. This variety may be one reason why some people feel embarrassed about their choices.
The survey was done online, so the results may not represent everyone. But it shows that, for many people, choosing a coffee is about more than just taste.
